relationship_rules: A model key is resource_type + generation_type + exact model_code + exact channel_code; case and channel differences are significant.
The 14 opaque models and 17 paths are a subset of the 18 model records, not additional models.
The 13 historical application options point to exactly 6 API records; eight nano_banana variants share one API but retain independent variant/SKU restrictions.
Same public model names in nano_banana options and Google model resources do not authorize shared contracts or automatic links.
Official Qwen pixel resources275/277 use the historical official-33 identities recorded on their meter rows. They are not the two dashscope_compatible Qwen3 models in the 18-model list.
All six Seedance Token rows point to app_api:seedance:create product140. They are not six additional model identities.
Request contract, SKU meter contract and applicable native published billing binding are independent AND conditions; satisfying one does not grant another.
No price, maximum_quantity, maximum_pixels_per_image, maximum_images, provider asset ID or input mapping is invented in this register.

review_findings.limitations: Only repository sources and existing observations were read. Historical observations are not current live status.
